text:
Priya Patel: heads-up — Vellum (customer) opened a P1: embeddings p99 spike on their dedicated pool after yesterday's model roll. They report a 3x tail latency increase and timeouts. CS says it's hitting user-facing flows. Can engineering owners confirm quick mitigation plan and owners?

Mike Chen: pinging eng-runtime + oncall. Do we have a link to traces / span ids? what’s the SLO breach %?

Claire (CS): link to CS ticket & traces: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-1129 and logs @  https://observability/redwood/vellum/trace/abcd1234 — p99 went from ~180ms -> ~560ms starting 03:20 UTC. Affects 3 routes. Customer is asking for a workaround asap.

SRE Bot: alert: dedicated-pool-vellum-3 p99-latency > 500ms (03:23 UTC) — incident created #INC-9876

Lina Gomez: quick hypothesis — the quantized kernel we onboarded yesterday changes KV cache page alignment; on short context lengths this increases kernel overhead. I can revert the kernel flag for that model variant and push a float16 fallback. Need ~2h to build + test artifact.

Jordan Park: alternative short-term: we can route Vellum traffic to the previous model revision (float16-legacy) via routing policy. That’s just a config change and can be done in ~30-45m with safety checks. I can own the routing change if we agree.

Ravi Desai: I can help validate customer-specific traffic rules and update the routing table. Also can run a quick canary to 10% before full cutover.

Mike Chen: preference for routing switch for immediate relief, then Lina does rollback build to avoid repeated config churn. @Jordan can you post the CLI snippet you’ll run? include rollback steps. Also set a canary and monitor p99.

Jordan Park: snippet: ```rwctl route update --customer vellum --model-modelset embeddings-prod --to model:float16-legacy --canary 10``` rollback: re-run with --to model:quantized-v2 and --canary 0 if we need to revert. I’ll open a PR for the routing change and tag @Ravi for approval.

Claire (CS): Vellum approves the canary, want full cutover if we see p99 drop under 250ms on canary. Please keep me posted every 15m.

Priya Patel: owners & timeline summary please: Jordan (routing + canary) — 45m, Lina (build fallback) — 2h, Mike (monitor + postmortem) — owner, Ravi (approval + validation) — owner, Claire (customer comms) — owner. Confirm and I'll update the CS ticket and execs.

Lina Gomez: confirmed. I’ll start the rollback build now and post artifact link when ready.

Jordan Park: starting canary in 10m. Will post metrics. tagging @SRE Bot for automated p99 alerts to this thread.

SRE Bot: scheduled check: canary p99 sampling every 1m for 30m. Alerts will ping here if p99 > 300ms.

Mike Chen: adding two quick checks for rollout: 1) top-10 callsites for embeddings to ensure no semantic regressions, 2) compare token throughput. If canary looks good at 10% after 15m, we’ll ramp to 100% over next 10m.

Claire (CS): customer updated: "we'll hold marketing push if this isn't stable by EOD" — they're anxious. Please prioritize.

Jordan Park: canary metrics after 8m: p99 on canary group = 220ms, overall p99 for customer = 310ms (still degrading on non-canary). Proceeding to ramp to 50%.

Ravi Desai: approved. I pushed routing approval flag. CI/QA check green.

Jordan Park: ramped to 50% at 03:55 UTC. Monitoring.

SRE Bot: alert cleared for dedicated-pool-vellum-3 p99-latency (03:58 UTC) — current p99=235ms.

Priya Patel: great job team. Next actions: Lina finishes rollback artifact (target: 2h), Mike to file postmortem with root cause and regression test, Jordan to document routing playbook for customer-level cutover. Claire will send customer update that we mitigated and will follow with RCA.

Mike Chen: noted — I'll start the postmortem template and include perf diffs + kernel flag diff. ETA for postmortem draft: 6h.

Lina Gomez: artifact uploaded: gs://redwood-artifacts/embeddings/float16-legacy/build-20260304-432.tar.gz. I'll open a PR to pin the modelset for Vellum and schedule a maintenance window if CS wants a permanent fix.

Claire (CS): Vellum asked for a permanent pin for now. Can we make that change and coordinate a maintenance window to test? They want minimal risk.

Jordan Park: we can pin via routing policy and follow up with a controlled deploy. I'll coordinate times.

Priya Patel: ok — I'll coordinate the maint window with Vellum and ops. Thanks everyone. If anything changes, ping this thread. :thumbsup:

Mike Chen: closing loop — will add follow-up tasks to the incident and assign owners.

SRE Bot: incident #INC-9876 status: mitigated -> monitoring. responders: Jordan Park, Lina Gomez, Mike Chen, Ravi Desai.
